results.description:
Clear your mind and relax with a unique audio-visual meditation experience.

Mesmerize combines engaging visuals with relaxing music and expertly crafted guided meditations to give you an all encompassing meditation experience.

BENEFITS
• Relieve Stress
• Lower Anxiety
• Better Sleep
• Overcome Depression
• Enhance Self-Awareness
• Deeper Relaxation
• Reduce Pain
• Overcome Addiction
• Increase Focus
• In fact, there are many more proven benefits to meditation. The impact of a consistent meditation practice can have a profound impact on the overall quality of your life.

FEATURES
• Engaging Visuals; uniquely hypnotic visuals designed to mesmerize you. Control their speed with a pinch gesture.
• Soothing Psycho-Acoustic Music; designed based on clinically validated principles to ease your body into a state of relaxation.
• Guided Meditations & Hypnosis; expertly crafted to help you on a range of topics.
• Nature Sounds and White Noise; including rain, ocean, thunder, train, fan and much more
• Sleepy Stories; doze off quickly with drowsy tales.
• Focus Music; music designed to help you beat distractions and concentrate.
• Visual Breathing; the speed of visuals will automatically adjust to your selected breathing pattern.
• 3D Voice
• Narration speed control
• Audio Fusion; mix outside audio with Mesmerize playback.
• Sleep Timer; set Mesmerize to automatically stop after a period of time.
• Variable Volumes; control the voice and music volumes separately to get your perfect balance between the two.
• Offline Compatible; download your favorite content to listen later in airplane mode.
• Random Modes; don't like choosing? Automatically chose a random from your favorites or a particular content category.
• Healthkit; track your "Mindful Minutes" when using Mesmerize
• Privacy Focused; no ads, no marketing emails, no logins or passwords, no accounts, no crazy permissions. In the age of information intrusion, Mesmerize is specifically designed to leave you alone.

MEDITATION & HYPNOSIS TOPICS
• Mindfulness
• Anxiety
• Gratitude
• Loving Kindness
• Emotional Wellbeing
• Forgiveness
• Self Care
• Affirmations
• Ease Pain
• Compassion
• Healing
• Sleep
• Chronic Pain
• Depression
• Addiction
• ADD & ADHD
• Focus & Study
• Sports Performance
• Quit Smoking & Vaping
• Breaking bad habits
• Erectile Dysfunction
• Dating Confidence
• Breathwork
• and more!

SCIENCE
Interested in learning the science behind Visual Meditation? You can learn more at www.MesmerizeApp.com/Science

SUBSCRIPTION AND TERMS
When you download Mesmerize you can opt into a 7-day free trial. Mesmerize offers auto-renewing monthly/yearly/weekly subscription options for access to the app's features and content. Your Mesmerize subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term and payment will be charged through your iTunes account. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. To avoid renewal, you must cancel at least 24 hours before your subscription or trial ends. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription.

As with all of our apps, if you would like to use Mesmerize but have trouble affording it please email us at support@mesmerizeapp.com so we can help you with our financial assistance program.

While we can't keep bringing great experiences to the world without making money, we know not everyone that needs access to our content can afford it, and we're happy to help.

Read more about our terms, conditions and privacy here:

https://mesmerizeapp.com/terms

Safety Warning: we present content that may not be appropriate for people with a history of seizures or epilepsy. Additionally do not use while driving, operating heavy machinery, or any settings where your full attention is required. Viewer discretion is advised.

advisories: Infrequent/Mild Alcohol, Tobacco, or Drug Use or References

Calm is the #1 app for sleep, meditation, and relaxation. Find anxiety relief, stress relief, and better sleep through breathing exercises, sleep sounds, deep sleep music, and mindfulness programs for insomnia, beginner meditation, and beyond. Downloaded by 180 million people worldwide.

Fall asleep faster with Sleep Stories, bedtime stories for adults narrated by Matthew McConaughey, Stephen Fry, P\!nk, Bob Ross, and more. Only on Calm.

Manage stress, relieve anxiety, improve your sleep cycle, and refocus your attention.

Apple App of the Year. Apple Editors' Choice. Happiest App in the World (Center for Humane Technology). 3M+ five-star reviews. Recommended by top psychologists, therapists, and mental health experts.

SLEEP STORIES — ONLY ON CALM

* Drift off to Matthew McConaughey's Wonder — a dreamy journey through the mysteries of the universe  
* Travel through the village of Provence with master storyteller Stephen Fry in Blue Gold  
* Fall asleep to the soothing brush strokes of beloved painter Bob Ross in Happy Little Zzzs  
* Tackle insomnia with 100+ exclusive Sleep Stories, new content added every month

MEDITATION & MINDFULNESS

* Beginner meditation to advanced practice — guided sessions for every experience level  
* Daily Calm with Tamara Levitt, Daily Jay with Jay Shetty, Daily Trip with Jeff Warren  
* Mindfulness topics: deep sleep, anxiety relief, stress relief, focus, breaking habits, self-care, personal growth, and more  
* 7- and 21-day mindfulness programs to build a lasting practice

ANXIETY RELIEF & RELAXATION

* Breathing exercises and breathwork to ease anxiety, stress, and insomnia  
* Bilateral stimulation music and neuroacoustic sounds for nervous system regulation and somatic relaxation  
* Guided breathwork for stress relief, anxiety relief, and deep calm  
* Stress management and self-healing through Dailies: programs for social anxiety, personal growth, and mood balance  
* Mindful movement and stretching with Daily Move

SLEEP SOUNDS, MUSIC & SOUNDSCAPES

* Calming music, nature sounds, and sleep sounds: ocean waves, heavy rain, campfire, and more  
* Exclusive focus and sleep music from top artists  
* Full soundscapes and sleep sounds to help you relax, meditate, and sleep soundly

ALSO FEATURING

* Daily Streaks & Mindful Minutes — emotion and mental health tracker  
* Calm saves your meditation and sleep sessions to your Apple Health app.

Mental health is health. Calm is for anyone looking to improve their sleep, manage stress, and address everyday anxiety. Meditation novice or seasoned expert.

Take a deep breath and find your Calm.

Calm is free to download and use. There are never any ads and some of the programs and features are free forever. Some content is only available through an optional paid subscription. Be sure to check out our Apple Watch app to quick-start breathing exercises and track your meditations.

Subscription pricing and terms:

Calm offers an auto-renewing monthly subscription at $14.99/month and an auto-renewing yearly subscription at $69.99/year to provide you with unlimited access to the Calm Collection while you maintain an active subscription.

Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your iTunes Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified. You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.

Read more about our terms and conditions here:
